messages:
natalie: External assessor wants a focused retest next week covering RBAC changes and KMS usage. Need owners + minimal evidence bundle (roles export, CloudTrail slice, presigned upload). Can we confirm? :clipboard:
kevin: I can handle KMS grants + presigned uploads. Plan: create a scoped grant for Decrypt only with encryption-context checks and issue presigned PUTs to s3://pt-evidence/assessor_186543/.
sam: I'll prepare the pt-assessor-readonly role (no iam:PassRole, no ListBucket). Timebox to 4h. I'll include an export `rbacctl export --flat --out=roles_186543.txt` and a short delegation map.
angela: I'll take vuln-720 (s3 ACL debug logs) and open a PR today with repro and verification steps. ETA 6h.
maria: Ops -> please confirm CloudTrail retention for staging. We need at least 90d export for key usage and AssumeRole events.
ops-bot: Prod CloudTrail: 365d. Staging: 45d. Recommend exporting staging slice to the evidence bucket; I'll kick off the export if you confirm time range.
kevin: I'll tag assessor sessions with `AssessorSession=186543` and include that in the session policy so CloudTrail filter is trivial. Example assume command I'll provide: `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-assessor-readonly --duration-seconds 14400 --serial-number ...`
assessor-bot: Assessor requires manifest.json with sha256 for each artifact and a README with reproduction steps. Prefer presigned PUTs for large files.
angela: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/945 fixing vuln-720; includes `aws s3api get-object-acl` verification.
sam: Manifest will include `redactions` list and hash values. No sensitive IDs in roles export; redact internal ARNs and note redactions in manifest.
kevin: Packaging layout: manifest.json, roles_186543.txt, cloudtrail_exports/, logs/, prs.md. I'll upload evidence zip and publish presigned GET for assessor after upload verification.
natalie: Owners: kevin KMS/evidence, sam RBAC/role, angela vuln fix, ops export. Retest window: Tue 09:00-13:00 PT. Please confirm availability and add thread_ts 1865432100 to PR descriptions.
kevin: Confirmed. Will post presigned links + grant ARN 24h before.
ops-bot: Tentative retest slot recorded: Tue 09:00-13:00 PT. Confirm 24h prior.
natalie: Thanks all. We'll do a final check-in 24h out. :white_check_mark:
